proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer cannot tell whether high DRAM utilization comes from excessive read traffic or from latency-bound low occupancy, so it cannot choose between reducing bytes moved and increasing parallelism.

rationale.dram__bytes_read.sum: HIGH -> reduce redundant reads via vectorization, shared-memory caching, or operation fusion; LOW -> focus on reducing write traffic or increasing parallelism to hide latency
rationale.sm__warps_active.avg.pct_of_peak_sustain: HIGH -> kernel is bandwidth-limited, optimize memory access pattern and reduce bytes moved; LOW -> kernel is latency-limited, increase occupancy by reducing registers, enlarging blocks, or launching more blocks
